scope: Engineering compatibility and application of repaired factual memory through EXISTING bounded two-hop hypothesis operator. Not new learned operator, semantic truth, heldout science or accepted model integration.

design.query_selection: Inspect only indexed row witnesses of the32768 frozen faults. For each true(s,p,m), require m among first16 base objects(s,p), and first indexed outgoing row of m exists. q=that row predicate. Deduplicate(s,p,q). Then choose512 queries evenly over ALL eligible contexts by floor(i*(eligible-1)/(511)),or all if fewer. No source-wide parse or benchmark-answer tuning.
design.controls: Independent raw-row bounded symbolic join, using its own projection/filter/cursor code with same visited-path budgets and candidate overlay sets. SAME information; expect tie. Direct fact retrieval cannot turn path into verified fact.
design.threshold: Every reference output equals corresponding native hypothesis output; repaired matches baseline on all selected queries; at least one faulted output differs (otherwise report engineering insufficient coverage without retuning). All hypotheses remain unverified; ordinary NativeKnowledgeSession.hypothesize API works.
design.changes: Add compatible manifest view and two_hop_candidates wrapper to BoundedFactRepair; delegate the unchanged native operator. Keep source and original failures frozen.

qualification: Focused compatibility+negative tests before image primary, Windows stable reproduction, mandatory final root/NKR05 and independent G29 both OS. Reuse PR1172; no merge/deployment/scientific_pass.
